intro.en: Degrees of friendship, love affairs, and the ceremonies where everyone meets.

ligar.en: to chat up, to pick up

asistir a.nota: False friend: it does not mean to assist.

caer bien.nota: Me cae bien: I like him.

titulo.en: How well do you know them?

texto.en:
**Degrees.** **Lo conozco de vista** (I have seen him around). **Es un conocido.** **Es un compañero.** **Es un amigo.** **Es un amigo íntimo.** **Es un amigo de toda la vida.** **Es como de la familia.**

**Liking people.** Not gustar, which suggests attraction, but **caer**: **me cae bien**, **me cae fatal**, **me cayó genial**.

**Getting on.** **Llevarse bien con**, **tratar con**, **relacionarse con**, **hacer amigos**, **mantener una relación**, **tener confianza con** alguien.

**Love.** **Ligar** (to chat someone up), **un ligue**, **salir con** alguien, **estar prometido**, **tener un compromiso**, **romper con** alguien, **tener un lío** (an affair, colloquial).

**Occasions.** **Un nacimiento**, **un bautizo**, **una primera comunión**, **una boda**, **un aniversario**. Twenty-five years of marriage are **las bodas de plata**, and fifty are **las bodas de oro**. **El santo** is the day of the saint you are named after.

**What happens there.** **El anfitrión** receives **los invitados**. There is **una ceremonia** and then **un banquete**. Someone **da un discurso** or **dice unas palabras**, everybody **brinda**, and the presents are **envueltos** and then **desenvueltos**.

**Verbs for events.** **Celebrar**, **organizar**, **cancelar**, **asistir a**. Careful: **asistir a una boda** is to attend it. To help is **ayudar**.

frases.es: El sábado pasado asistí a las bodas de plata de Blanca y Rodrigo, unos amigos de toda la vida.
frases.en: Last Saturday I attended the silver wedding of Blanca and Rodrigo, lifelong friends.
analisis: las bodas de plata de Blanca y Rodrigo
unos amigos de toda la vida

frases.es: Se conocieron en un bautizo, ligaron esa misma tarde y, contra todo pronóstico, no han roto nunca.
frases.en: They met at a christening, hit it off that same afternoon and, against all the odds, have never broken up.

frases.es: Había casi cien invitados, de los que yo conocía bien a diez y de vista a otros veinte.
frases.en: There were almost a hundred guests, of whom I knew ten well and another twenty by sight.

frases.es: Después de una ceremonia sencilla hubo un banquete que duró hasta la noche.
frases.en: After a simple ceremony there was a banquet that lasted until night.

frases.es: El hijo mayor dio un discurso tan divertido que hasta su abuela, que nunca se ríe, acabó llorando de risa.
frases.en: The eldest son gave such a funny speech that even his grandmother, who never laughs, ended up crying with laughter.

frases.es: Brindamos por los anfitriones y por que cumplan otros veinticinco años juntos.
frases.en: We drank a toast to the hosts and to their having another twenty-five years together.

frases.es: Me sentaron al lado de un primo de Rodrigo que al principio me cayó fatal y con el que acabé bailando.
frases.en: They sat me next to a cousin of Rodrigo's whom I couldn't stand at first and with whom I ended up dancing.
analisis: al lado de un primo de Rodrigo
que al principio me cayó fatal

pregunta.en: According to the text, where did Blanca and Rodrigo meet?

At a banquet.en: The banquet is at their anniversary.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what did the writer think of Rodrigo's cousin at first?

She knew him by sight.en: The text does not say that.

pregunta.en: Complete: I like your brother (as a person).

cae.en: Caer bien: to be liked as a person.

gusta.en: Me gusta tu hermano suggests attraction.

lleva.en: Llevarse bien needs me llevo bien con él.

texto.en: I only know him by sight.

explicacion.en: Conocer de vista: to know by sight.

texto.en: I only see him when I know him.

explicacion.en: Conocer de vista: to know by sight.

traduccion.en: We drank a toast to the hosts of the party.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write the account of a wedding or another celebration you attended, with details of the guests and the ceremony.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Explain aloud the difference between an acquaintance, a friend and a close friend, with examples from your life.
